content: कद् I. €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (कद्यते) To be confounded or confused, to suffer mentally. --II. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (कदते) also €1 <ab>P.</ab> .²1 To cry, to weep or shed tears. .²2 To grieve. .²3 To call. .²4 To kill or hurt; see कन्द्.

कद् {%ind.%} [कद्-क्विप] <ab>Ved.</ab> A particle of interrogation, ‘where’. This particle which is a substitute for the word कु is often used as the first member of a <ab>comp.</ab> and expresses the senses of badness, littleness, deterioration, uselessness, defectiveness <ab>&c.</ab> of anything; नियच्छ मन्युं कददाः स्म मानः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 5. 28</ls>.
